svg.title: Evidence for an architecture decision
svg.desc: Five ordered stages establish an architecture decision: workload objectives, architecture selection, dependency assessment, capacity sizing, support ownership. Each stage supplies evidence for the next stage. Revisit the design if a required gate cannot be met.
svg.text: Module 1 | Read from top to bottom.

g.text: Name the failure domain to survive.
Assign operational owners. Name escalation leads.
